segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
Overwhelmed with wonder, I turned to my guide
like a small child who always runs
for comfort

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
There where he trusts the most; and she, like a mother
who instantly comforts her pale and breathless child
with a voice that always soothes him,
said to me: "Don't you know you are in heaven?
Don't you know that all of heaven is holy
and everything done here springs from righteous zeal?
You can now imagine how the singing would have transformed you,
and how my smile would have affected you,
since that cry startled you so much—
a cry whose prayers, if you had understood them,
would have already revealed to you the vengeance
you will witness before you die.
The sword of justice here strikes neither hastily nor late,
however it may seem to one
who waits for it in fear or desire.
But turn now toward the others,
for you will see most illustrious spirits
if you direct your gaze as I tell you."
As seemed good to her, I turned my eyes
and saw a hundred small spheres that together
made each other more beautiful with their mingled light.
I stood like one who holds back
the urgency of his desire, not daring
to ask questions, so afraid of going too far.
And the largest and most radiant
among those pearls came forward
to satisfy my curiosity about it.
Then from within it I heard: "If you could see,
as I do, the love that burns
among us, your thoughts would be spoken;
but so that waiting won't delay you
from reaching the highest goal, I will answer
even the thought you're so reluctant to voice.
That mountain on whose slope Cassino stands
was once frequented on its summit
by a deluded and misguided people;
and I am he who first carried up there
the name of Him who brought to earth
the truth that lifts us so high.
Such abundant grace shone upon me
that I drew all the neighboring towns away
from the impious worship that seduced the world.
These other flames were all contemplative men,
kindled by that heat
which makes holy flowers and fruits spring forth.
Here is Macarius, here is Romualdus,
here are my brothers who within the cloisters
kept their steps steady and their hearts constant."

segments.speaker: dante
segments.text:
The affection you show
in speaking with me, and the kindness
I see and recognize in all your ardor,
have expanded my confidence
like the sun does the rose when it unfolds
as fully as it has the power to do.
Therefore I beg you, and you must assure me, father,
if I can receive grace enough
to see you with your face unveiled.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
Then he: "Brother, your lofty desire
will be fulfilled in the highest sphere,
where all desires are fulfilled, both others' and my own.
There every longing is perfect, mature, and complete;
in that sphere alone
every part exists where it has always been,
for it is not in space, nor turns on axes,
and our ladder reaches up to it,
which is why it steals away from your sight.
Up to that height the Patriarch Jacob saw it
extending its celestial portion,
when it appeared to him so crowded with angels.
But now no one lifts
his feet from earth to climb it, and my Rule
below remains mere waste of paper.
The walls that once were an abbey
have become dens of thieves, and the cowls
are sacks full of rotten flour.
But even heavy usury is not taken up
so much against God's pleasure as that fruit
which drives the hearts of monks insane;
for whatever the Church holds in trust
belongs to those who ask for it in God's name,
not to one's family or something worse.
The flesh of mortals is so weak
that good beginnings down below don't last
from the oak's sprouting to its bearing acorns.
Peter began with neither gold nor silver,
I with prayer and fasting,
and Francis founded his order with humility.
And if you look at each one's beginning
and then see where he has wandered,
you'll see the white has turned to brown.
Truly the Jordan flowing backward
and the sea's parting, when God willed it, were less
miraculous to witness than help here would be."
So he spoke to me; then withdrew
to his company, and the company closed together;
then like a whirlwind all were swept upward.
The gentle Lady urged me up behind them
over that stairway with a single gesture,
so completely did her power overcome my nature;
nor here below, where we go up and down
by natural law, was motion ever so swift
that it could compare to my flight.
Reader, so may I return to that devout
triumph for which I often weep
and beat my breast for my sins—
you could not have thrust your finger in fire
and pulled it out again as quickly as I saw
the sign that follows Taurus and found myself within it.
O glorious stars, O light pregnant
with mighty power, from which I acknowledge
all my genius, whatever it may be!
With you was born and hid himself with you
he who is father of all mortal life,
when I first breathed the Tuscan air;
and then when grace was freely granted me
to enter the great wheel that turns you round,
your region was assigned to me.
To you my soul devoutly sighs
at this moment, that it may gain strength
for the difficult passage that draws it onward.

segments.speaker: st_benedict
segments.text: You are so close to final salvation,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
Beatrice began, "that you should now
have your eyes clear and sharp;
and therefore, before you go farther in,
look down once more and see how vast a world
you have already placed beneath your feet,
so that your heart, as joyful as it can be,
may present itself to the triumphant throng
that comes rejoicing through this rounded sky."
With my sight I traveled back through each
of the seven spheres, and I saw this globe
so small that I smiled at its humble appearance;
and I approve that judgment as best
which considers it least; he who thinks
of other things may truly be called righteous.
I saw Latona's daughter shining
without that shadow which once made me think
she was both rare and dense in substance.
The face of your son, Hyperion,
I endured here, and saw how Maia and Dione
move themselves around and near him.
Then appeared the tempering influence of Jupiter
between his father and son, and I could clearly see
the changes they make in their positions;
and all seven revealed to me
how large they are, how swift,
and how far apart their dwelling places.
The little threshing floor that makes us so fierce,
revolving with the eternal Twins,
appeared completely to me from mountains to harbors!
Then I turned my eyes back to the beautiful eyes.
